description: BigCommerce is an ecommerce platform with REST and GraphQL APIs for storefronts, apps and store data.
auth_notes: Store-level API accounts give an access token sent in X-Auth-Token; app-level accounts use an OAuth grant code flow.
gate_detail: Developers sign up for a free trial sandbox store, then create API credentials in Settings > API Accounts. A live production store presumably needs a paid plan; sources do not state this.
api_scope: REST Management API, REST and GraphQL Storefront APIs, GraphQL Account and Admin APIs, Payments, Customer Login and Current Customer APIs.
mcp_notes: Official docs list Storefront MCP, WebMCP and Store Management MCP, with enablement and permissions; URL not stated.
blocker_detail: Only a free trial store is described for testing; production store plan requirements are not stated.

evidence.quote: Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data.
Navigate to Settings > API Accounts in your store control panel.
Generate access tokens with the BigCommerce-initiated grant code authorization flow.
Use REST and GraphQL APIs to manage products, orders, customers, and store settings programmatically.
Webhooks do not persist upon account deletion.

uncertainties: Paid-plan requirement for production inferred, not stated.
MCP URL and exact availability not in sources.
Quoted MCP evidence is only a heading.
